question: A certain sum amounts to Rs. 1,543.50 when invested for 2 years at 5% per annum compound interest. What is the sum (in Rs.)?
solution:
Given:

The sum amounts to Rs. 1,543.50 when invested for 2 years at 5% per annum compound interest.
